title: Profile tabbed UI; in-page Structure CRUD on view/edit; Main tab AJAX save to POST /api/profile/update; structure store API id + audit; Playwright structure-tab suite and local admin env defaults
summary: Profile view and edit now use Bootstrap tabs (Main, Socio Economic, Structure, Validation Data). The Structure tab embeds a shared modal (profile_structure_crud.php) and structure-tab.js: list via GET /api/profile/{id}/structures, full CRUD via multipart POST to /api/structure/store|update|delete with image fields and remove[] arrays. Api StructureController storeApi returns { success, data: { id } } and AuditLog::record on create. Profile edit Main tab saves through form.js to POST /api/profile/update/{id} with JSON response. Playwright: profile-structure-tab.spec.ts (tabs, modal, create with PNG + assert store + table); profile-edit.spec.ts aligned with AJAX save. playwright.config.ts sets ADMIN_USER/ADMIN_PASS when CI is unset; package devDependency @types/node.

items: Tabbed layout: Main, Socio Economic, Structure, Validation Data
Structure tab includes partial profile_structure_crud.php when user has view_structure or add_structure

openAdd/openView/openEdit; submitCreate/submitUpdate with FormData; refreshTable from GET /api/profile/{id}/structures
Delete confirm → POST /api/structure/delete/{id}; image lightbox integration where modal exists

view.js: structure detail modal removed where superseded by tab; image lightbox hooks for structure tab
